description: Typed extraction of obligations and requirements. Record only what the documents say; a later program compares the entries.

statuses.binding: The text plainly requires this value.
statuses.selected_realization: The text presents this value as its author's revisable choice of how to do the work, not as a requirement.
statuses.unspecified: The text says nothing about this property.
statuses.ambiguous: The text supports more than one reading. Do not choose; list every reading in 'readings'.

initiator.meaning: Who must initiate or issue the action.

outcome_owner.meaning: Who or what must bring about the outcome.

verifier.meaning: Who must establish that the outcome holds.

verifier_independence.meaning: Whether the verifier must be independent of the acting component.

path_fact.meaning: Required facts about how the outcome is produced.

field_rules: binding and selected_realization require a non-empty 'value'.
unspecified requires an empty 'value' and no 'readings'.
ambiguous requires an empty 'value' and at least two different 'readings', each a non-empty list of allowed tokens.
'any' means the text deliberately leaves the party open; it is never combined with another role in one value or reading.
verifier_independence values are lists of exactly one of 'required' or 'not_required'.
any use of 'other' requires 'other_text' quoting the entry's document.
quoting: Every quoted string (span, reference text, owner span, other_text) must be one contiguous passage of the named document. Line breaks and runs of spaces may be written as single spaces, Markdown emphasis characters (* _ `) may be left out, and curly quotes may be written straight. Nothing else may differ: no ellipses, no joined passages, no paraphrase.

entry.document: a document id exactly as shown in the task (DOC-1, DOC-2, ...)
entry.role: 'parent' for an entry from a PARENT or SOURCE document; 'derived' for an entry from a DERIVED document
entry.fields: object mapping property name to {status, value, readings?, other_text?}; omit a property only if it is unspecified
entry.semantics_owner: parent entries only, optional: {status, names: [every name the documents use for the party that owns the meaning of this requirement], document: the document id that says so, span: text quoted from that document}
entry.asserted_as: derived entries only: one of inherited, proposed, new, realization_choice, unchanged
entry.scope: derived entries only: partial or complete
entry.baseline: derived entries only: for a complete or unchanged entry: the list of parent entry ids it replaces or restates; otherwise an empty list
entry.references_made: derived entries only: list of the references the derived document itself makes for this requirement: {kind: specific|general, text: the citation quoted from the derived document, target_document: a document id or null, properties: [the property names the citation is offered for]}; empty list if it cites nothing
entry.support_candidates: derived entries only: object mapping each property to a list of parent entry ids that bear on that property, whether or not they fully state it; empty list if none
entry.candidate_alignment: derived entries only: optional object mapping a property to 'same_condition' when its several candidates state requirements on the same thing under the same condition, so they apply together; omit the property otherwise
entry.adopted_by: derived entries only: optional: {status, names: [the party the document says decided, approved or adopted this requirement; not a party that merely states, reviews or recommends it], document, span}
